result.card: This pull request implements runtime computation of headers synchronization DoS parameters (commitment period and redownload buffer size) at node startup, removing the hardcoded constants from chainparams and deleting contrib/devtools/headerssync-params.py. Previously, maintainers had to manually recompute and commit these parameters for each release by estimating the software's future operational lifetime, risking human error or parameter degradation over time. Additionally, the new C++ optimization model corrects a minor flaw in the original script where attackers were assumed to be constrained to 2000-header batch boundaries. The change adds unit tests against precomputed exact optima and fuzz targets covering the parameter search over all valid inputs. There are no dependencies.
